name: comp-401
title: Avatar Group 24px
description: Renders a group of four circular avatars at 24px size with negative margins to create an overlap effect. Each avatar has a thin ring border using theme background color.
use_when: A slightly larger avatar group for cards or list items where more visual prominence is needed than the 20px variant.
avoid_when: More than four avatars or when you need individual avatar state — this is a static group layout.
a11y: Each image has alt text. No interactive elements or motion; passive layout.
